final_message.text:
I have successfully parsed `workspace/app.log` and generated `workspace/errors.json`.

### Summary of how the file was parsed:
- **Filtering & Matching:** Scanned `workspace/app.log` line by line, identifying log entry headers matching `<timestamp> [<LEVEL>] <service>: <message>` (supporting case-insensitive levels). Filtered out non-error entries (keeping only `ERROR` and `CRITICAL`).
- **Timestamps & Normalization:** Parsed ISO-8601 timestamps with UTC offsets (`Z`, `+HH:MM`, `-HH:MM`), converted them to UTC (`datetime` with `zoneinfo`/`timedelta`), and formatted them as `YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ`.
- **Extra Lines & Exceptions:** Associated subsequent non-header lines (such as Python tracebacks) with the current entry, extracting the last line of the traceback as the `exception` value (or `null` if no traceback was present).
- **Repeat Counts & Aggregation:** Summed up `N` from any following `-- last message repeated N times --` lines to compute `repeat_count` (1 + sum of N), and aggregated the total error counts per service into `counts_by_service`.

Files created/modified:
- `workspace/errors.json`
